records.scope: Large public-interest undertakings or parent groups exceeding 500 average employees, subject to national extensions, group exemptions and materiality.
records.note: Article 1 (19a/29a), recital 7 and Article 4; EFRAG Appendix 4.6 pp.8-12 lists national laws; ESMA 2023 enforcement report confirms most first reports in 2018 for FY2017. Earlier Danish/Greek national phase retained where already documented. Material environmental information, not an unconditional Scope 1-3 metric mandate.

records.title: France public GHG inventories (Grenelle II)
records.scope: Private legal persons over 500 employees in metropolitan France (250 overseas); stated public entities separately covered. Not annual mandatory Scope 3 for every issuer.
records.note: Official report accompanying Ordonnance 2015-1737: inventories mandatory from 31 December 2012, publication on company website; original three-year cycle, subsequently four years. Successor NFRD retained separately.

records.title: IFRS reporting implementation: Norway
records.scope: Consolidated accounts of listed Norwegian entities; EEA coordinated application.
records.note: Finanstilsynet annual report 2006, financial reporting supervision: listed companies required to use IFRS for consolidated accounts from 2005.

records.title: IFRS reporting implementation: Philippines
records.scope: Listed companies and other entities within PFRS perimeter; local modifications/sector-specific reliefs.
records.note: World Bank Philippines corporate governance ROSC, 2006: IFRS/PFRS required for listed companies, banks and SEC-regulated entities effective 1 January 2005; sector reliefs remain.

records.title: IFRS reporting implementation: Singapore
records.scope: Singapore-incorporated SGX-listed companies; earlier SFRS convergence distinct from IFRS-identical framework.
records.note: IFRS Foundation profile: IFRS-identical SFRS(I) mandatory for Singapore-incorporated SGX-listed companies from periods starting 1 January 2018. Daske's earlier 2003 local-convergence episode is retained as a different event, not substituted.

excluded_or_deferred.reason: Main-segment recognised-standard requirement permits US GAAP; cannot treat every issuer as compelled to use IFRS.
Daske Table 6 historical 2005 coding differs from later modified-IFRS regime in official profile; actual operative national start remains unresolved. No synthetic date added.
